disposition: PASS for the four d=-1 h=2 central points, assuming the stated preceding normalized chart; no Lean run or blanket review of the other eight cases.
checks: C1=-(N+1)/2, D1=-a(1+N')/2, and ad C1+D1=a(N-N')/2=±1200a has exact v2=4. U=C1−x is a unit. The two-dimensional y-base has maximal ideal (x,y) by 2U=x²+y²; w² has order at least four. The homogeneous tangent w²=0 leaves only x,y directions.

Independent substitution in U²w²/x⁴ gives (1+t²)[ad(C1−x)+(ad x+D1)(1+t²)], exactly the stated bracket. (t−1)²=(1+t²)(U−x²t)/U and the latter denominator is a unit along the exceptional line. The divided monic for E is integral, in the original field, finite over the w/x ratios with inverse w/x=x(t−1)E/U. On the other chart E'=−s'E, giving the asserted swapped equation, including the ad y s' term. At x=0,t≠0 the ad x term is a uniform linear term since 2 lies in x² and L−1 in x²t. At s'=0 the side tangent p²+ad y s'+κy² is smooth over the algebraic closure. The normality/field-reconstruction argument is local to these charts, preserving the starting normal model on its complement.

At t=0 the shift gives the exact mixed-characteristic equation v²+x²Mtv+xJt²=D0 L M⁴ x⁸, J a unit. After n main blowups t=xⁿP,v=xⁿW, exponent is 8−2n, as stated. Side charts x=sR divide the old RHS to a unit times s^(8−2n)R^(10−2n), affording only the extra quadratic R² in round four. Every side tangent contains W'²+sR J-bar (+κR²), hence is smooth. The leading v-square forces the indicated two charts to cover. Nonzero residual equation in regular ambient scale chart prevents spurious scale torsion on each ordinary strict transform.

At n=4 division by M² gives W²+x²M'PW+xJ'P²=D0L. W=1 and the plane has only P=0 critical since 1−D0L is divisible by x². In the final x chart t=x⁵Q, so (1−D0L)/x²=(1−D0)M/2+D0(1−L)/x² has both constant and first linear coefficient independent of Q. The tangent critical polynomial J'-bar Q²+M'-bar Q+constant has nonzero derivative, including over algebraic residue extensions. Each further tangent z²+xF' q+(possible xz,x²) is smooth, as is the other direction Z²+PR J'-bar+κR². These cover all directions and all residual critical points, with no assumption that the separable roots are rational.
scope: This is the second review for the d=-1 portion only of the twelve-case finite-source geometry dossier, not a separate proof of preceding charts or a Lean computation.
